New Homes For Sale in Georgia!

From the majestic mountain peaks of the Chattahoochee National Forest to the 700 square miles encompassing the world’s largest swamp, there’s a lot more to Georgia than peaches, pecans, and peanuts.

Georgia is known as the Peach State, but it’s also the country's top producer of Vidalia onions. The state’s onions are considered some of the sweetest in the world. In addition to Coca-Cola, Georgia is also home to the headquarters of Chick-fil-A, CNN, Delta Airlines, the Centers for Disease Control, and Home Depot.

 

Georgia is also a state of “firsts”, including the first state to lower the voting age from 21 to 18. Atlanta, Georgia’s capital, is also home to well-known civil rights activist Martin Luther King, Jr.
